text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: DIVUD/LND/ACQUI/13/4-6. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2021/BOI/173. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands required for a public purpose. Description of the land/servitude to be acquired: The 02 allotments of lands, referred in sheet No. 01, Block 01 of Cadastral Map No. 421353, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Wathuwaththa Village in No. 1484 Wathuwaththa Grama Niladhari Division in Udubaddawa Divisional Secretary's Division in Kurunegala District of North Western Province. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Pansal Watta, Palugahapitiyawela, Kanagonpitiyekumbura, Wathuwaththa, Gangoda, Thalgahawela; Claimed by: The Government; Original Claimant:Suriya Pathirannahalage Lalithasiri Pathirathna; Extent: 0.0834 Hectare.

Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Hiriyaddahena; Claimed by: The Government; Original Claimant: Suriya Pathirannahalage Sumanawathi, has been issued a Jayabhumi grant letter under the Land Development Ordinance; Extent: 0.0035 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat on 11.06.2025 at 10.00 a.m. And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 05.06.2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Nංඅඎ඄ൺ D. Dൺඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ, Divisional Secretary, Udubaddawa. Divisional Secretariat, Udubaddawa. On 21st April 2025 EOG 04 - 0176

2 A III ෙකොටස - ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් අති විෙශෂ ගැසට් පතය - 2025.04.25 Pൺඋඍ III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 25.04.2025

Corrigenda THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) THE date for the land ownership inquiry under Section 7 of the notice published on pages 1A and 2A of Part III in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2254/8 dated 16.11.2021, of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, is amended to 21.04.2025. Accordingly, all persons who are interested for the land published in that notice are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Homagama on the 21st day of April 2025 at 9.30 a.m.

Furthermore, hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the day of 07.04.2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of the compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount. B. A. D. Cඁංඇඍඁൺ඄ൺ, Divisional Secretary, Homagama. Divisional Secretariat, Homagama. On 11th day of April, 2025 EOG 04 - 0177
